title: Client Retentions & Renewals Adviser
description:
Client Retention & Renewals Adviser

Gateshead 31,734 + Bonus Realistic OTE 37,734

Represent the Business. Own the Relationship. Protect the Contract.

Office Angels are recruiting for a Client Retention & Renewals Adviser to join a successful and established organisation based in Gateshead. This is a high-quality, client-facing commercial role for someone confident building relationships, managing renewals and discussing contracts, pricing and value with key stakeholders.

As a Client Retention & Renewals Executive, you'll become a key point of contact for an established portfolio of clients across the UK. You'll conduct client meetings via video and telephone, manage commercial renewal conversations and build relationships with key stakeholders. You'll understand client requirements, discuss contracts and pricing, address concerns and ensure clients continue to see value in their relationship with the business.

This is not a high-volume contact centre environment. You'll manage relationships, own renewal opportunities and represent the business directly to clients.

What You'll Get
- 31,734 basic + monthly performance-related bonus Realistic OTE 37,734
- Monday to Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm No weekends
- Hybrid working after qualifying service
- Company pension
- Health Shield, including private dental and medical benefits
- Employee discounts and wellbeing platform
- Full product and systems training
- Ongoing career development
- Central Gateshead location with excellent transport links

Holiday Set Up
- Up to 37 days' annual leave including Bank Holidays
- Annual leave is be taken during half term periods, with up to two days' annual leave permitted during each term
- During August, working hours are reduced to 9:30am to 3:00pm
- Five days' annual leave are allocated to the August wellbeing shutdown week, with additional shutdown over Christmas

A Commercial Role With Real Responsibility

You'll manage a portfolio of existing clients and renewal opportunities, taking ownership throughout the renewal journey. Clients may be responsible for significant purchasing decisions, so you'll need to be comfortable having commercial conversations around contracts, pricing, value and requirements. You'll identify potential renewal risks, explore concerns directly and represent the business with professionalism and credibility.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing client relationships throughout the renewal lifecycle
- Conducting professional client meetings via video, telephone and email
- Building trusted relationships with key contacts and stakeholders
- Understanding client requirements, objectives and concerns
- Managing renewals through to completion
- Discussing contracts, pricing, terms and renewal options
- Preparing quotations and commercial proposals
- Handling objections and identifying potential renewal risks
- Re-engaging previous clients and strengthening existing relationships
- Maintaining an accurate renewal pipeline and CRM records
- Working with internal teams to ensure a seamless client experience
- Achieving agreed retention, renewal and performance objectives

About You

You may have experience in account management, customer success, renewals, retention, consultative sales, business development, relationship management or contract management.

You'll bring:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- A polished and professional approach to client relationships
- Confidence discussing pricing, contracts and value
- Strong relationship-building, influencing and negotiation skills
- Confidence handling objections and commercially sensitive conversations
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple client relationships and renewal opportunities
- Confidence using CRM systems, with Microsoft Dynamics or similar experience advantageous

Experience within education, public sector, technology, software or another service-led organisation would also be beneficial.

Apply Now

If you have experience in client relationships, account management, renewals, retention, customer success or consultative sales and you're ready for a role where you can take genuine ownership of commercial relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note: An Enhanced DBS check is required for the successful candidate and will be funded by the company.

Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Office Angels is an employment agency and business. We are an equal-opportunities employer who puts expertise, energy and enthusiasm into improving everyone's chance of being part of the workplace. We respect and appreciate people of all ethnicities, generations, religious beliefs, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities and more. By showcasing talents, skills and unique experiences in an inclusive environment, we help individuals thrive. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Office Angels acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. Office Angels UK is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Office Angels. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Outbound Sales Executive
description:
We have an excellent opportunity to join a well-established manufacturing business based in County Durham. The company supplies a range of durable products to both public and private sector organisations across the UK and is continuing to grow its customer base.

Responsibilities
- Identifying and developing new business opportunities
- Make outbound calls to prospective customers, introducing the company's products and services.
- Follow up quotations and sales enquiries promptly.
- Identify customer needs and effectively communicate the benefits of relevant solutions.
- Maintain accurate records of customer interactions within the CRM system and ensure follow-up actions are completed.
- Qualify leads and assess potential opportunities for the wider sales team.
- Work closely with colleagues to develop targeted business development campaigns and improve outreach activity.

Job Requirements
- Previous sales experience with a proven track record of achieving or exceeding targets.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and objectives.
- Experience using CRM systems.
- Good understanding of sales processes, lead generation and business development techniques.
- Full UK driving licence.

Working hours

Monday to Thursday 8.30am 5pm

Friday 8.30am 1.30pm

Approximately 1 in 6 Fridays you will require working until 4:00pm to provide cover for incoming customer calls.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Are you an experienced Sales Advisor in the New Build Housing sector, looking for something new?

Approach Personnel are proud to be partnered with a privately owned, regional developer who are currently on the look out for a Sales Advisor to join them on a permanent basis out of their site in Newcastle under Lyme. As a New Build Housing Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for playing a crucial role in the commercial success of our developments, by hitting your sales targets on a quarterly basis, ensuring compliance and standards are upheld through the entirety of the sales process.

What's in it for you?
- Competitive basic salary of 32,000 + UNCAPPED OTE
- Continued personal development opportunities
- Private medical care
- Generous annual leave entitlement + bank holidays

What are we looking for?
- Prior, proven experience of working in sales for a new build housing developer.
- Impecable communication skills with both clients and customer experience.
- Commercially astute with a good understanding of the market and competitors
- Full UK's driving licence

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage the sales activities for allocated developments, including lead management, customer appointments, reservations, sales transactions, legal completions and the sale of finishing touches, to ensure achievement of sales targets.
- Update and maintain the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to log the customer journey and facilitate timely and accurate management information.
- Work cohesively with other departments across the Operating Company such as Construction, Commercial and Legal to ensure achievement of completion targets and timely updates relating to plot progress.
- Comply with the Group Health, Safety and Environment Policy and ensure compliance of prospective buyers during site visits and pre-sale and new home demonstrations to minimise incidents and accidents.

title: Sales Executive
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Internal Sales Executive to join a growing, successful business providing technical services and solutions to the UK construction industry.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys B2 B sales, outbound calling, and developing customer relationships. You ll be responsible for generating new business opportunities while also managing and growing an established portfolio of customers.

The Role

As an Internal Sales Executive, you will:
- Make proactive outbound calls to prospective B2 B customers
- Identify key decision-makers and generate new business opportunities
- Qualify prospects to understand their requirements, budgets and upcoming projects
- Book qualified appointments and opportunities for field-based Business Development Managers
- Manage and develop an existing portfolio of smaller B2 B accounts
- Re-engage dormant customers and identify opportunities to increase spend
- Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities
- Respond to sales enquiries, quotes and orders generated through your activity
- Maintain accurate customer and sales information within the CRM
- Build strong, long-term relationships with customers across the UK

About You

To be considered for this role, you should have:
- Previous experience within B2 B telesales, internal sales, lead generation or business development
- Proven experience making outbound calls and working towards sales targets
- Confidence overcoming objections and speaking with key decision-makers
- A strong telephone manner with excellent rapport-building and questioning skills
- The ability to identify and qualify genuine commercial opportunities
- Good organisational and time-management skills
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office
- A proactive, resilient and self-motivated approach to sales

Experience within construction supplies, plant hire, tool hire, technical services, engineering or industrial sectors would be advantageous, although this is not essential.

Previous experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Appointment Setter, Telesales Executive, Internal Sales Executive or Business Development Executive would also be highly relevant.

What s on Offer
- Opportunity to work from Leeds or the Northeast
- Established portfolio of existing B2 B customers
- Genuine opportunity to generate and develop new business
- Work with an established and growing national organisation
- Support from experienced field-based Business Development Managers
- Varied role combining new business development and account management
- Excellent opportunity for long-term career development

Additional Information

This is a proactive sales position and will suit someone who genuinely enjoys picking up the phone, building relationships and creating commercial opportunities. The role has a target of approximately 35 proactive outbound calls per day, split between new business development and existing account management.

Due to the high volume of applications, we aim to respond to all candidates, although this is not always possible. If you have not been contacted within 5 days, please assume your application has not been successful on this occasion. However, we may retain your details for future opportunities.

title: Client Adviser
description:
If you are doing solid commercial insurance work in Newcastle but feel your current role has become too narrow, too transactional or too predictable, this could be worth a look. This Client Adviser position would suit an Account Handler who enjoys looking after established client relationships, wants more variety in the work and is keen to develop further into international business without stepping away from the core discipline of good commercial insurance handling.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in getting the detail right, keeps clients informed properly and understands that good service in commercial insurance is not about noise or theatre. It is about judgement, reliability and being trusted by clients and colleagues alike.

The opportunity

The position sits within a commercial team handling a broad range of business, including clients with international exposures. You will be working closely with Account Executives, insurers and clients, supporting the placement and day-to-day management of commercial insurance programmes across multiple classes. The mix of work should appeal to an Account Handler or Client Adviser who wants to stay close to clients while broadening their exposure to more complex and internationally minded risks.

For the right person, this offers a sensible next move. You do not need to be coming from a fully international insurance background already, but you do need a strong grounding in commercial insurance and the confidence to handle client queries, renewals, adjustments and market interaction professionally.

What the role involves

You will be responsible for supporting a portfolio of commercial clients and helping to make sure their insurance arrangements are administered accurately and managed properly throughout the policy cycle. You will be dealing with existing business, renewals, mid-term adjustments, insurer negotiations and client servicing, while working as part of a team that values technical quality and consistency.

Responsibilities
- Support the servicing of commercial insurance clients across a range of sectors and risk profiles
- Handle renewals, mid-term adjustments, new business support and general account administration
- Liaise with insurers to obtain terms, negotiate where appropriate and secure suitable cover
- Prepare client documentation and ensure records, systems and correspondence are accurate and up to date
- Work with Account Executives and senior colleagues to deliver a high standard of client service
- Assist with business that includes overseas or international elements, depending on experience
- Build a sound understanding of client needs and contribute to long-term account retention

Who this role could suit
- An Account Handler or Client Adviser with commercial insurance experience
- Someone working in a broking environment who wants broader, more interesting client exposure
- A technically capable insurance professional who values accuracy, relationships and steady progression
- An individual based in or around Newcastle who wants a role with genuine long-term potential
- A commercial insurance professional interested in international work, global programmes or cross-border client activity

Salary and benefits
- Salary is negotiable depending on experience
- Strong overall benefits package
- Supportive team environment
- Real scope for progression
- Exposure to quality commercial and international insurance work
- Newcastle-based opportunity with an established market presence

The next step

If you are an Account Handler or Client Adviser and would like a more detailed conversation about where this role could take you, I would be happy to talk you through it in confidence. There is no pressure and no hard sell, just a straightforward discussion about the role, the team and whether it feels like the right move for you.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR NEWCASTLE UNDER LYME - £26,500 - £30,000 PLUS COMMISSION

Are you a dynamic and enthusiastic individual with a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences while driving sales? Join our clients vibrant team as a Customer Service and Sales Agent, where your fun and motivated spirit will help push the boundaries of customer service and sales excellence! Confidence is key and you will be dealing with customers very quickly, although ongoing training and support will continue.

COMPANY BACKGROUND

Our client is an independent company that works on a national basis. They offer a market leading customer service experience. Great customer service is at the heart of the business. They have continued to grow month on month and gain a reputation for offering a competitive service and second to none customer service. This is a small business and every single employee is a member of the family, as are the customers.

CUSTOMER SERVICE JOB PURPOSE

Develop a culture of customer satisfaction through timely and thorough handling of complaints, queries and general enquiries. Working in a fast-paced environment, to address customer issues via the telephone or email.

CUSTOMER SERVICE DUTIES
- Deliver Exceptional Service: Engage with customers in a friendly and upbeat manner, providing them with incredible support and assistance.
- Sales Dynamo: Harness your customer service and communication skills to promote and sell our products and services. Achieve and exceed targets by empathising with customer needs and providing tailored solutions. NO COLD CALLING
- Motivated Team Player: Collaborate with fellow team members to sales brainstorm creative ideas and strategies that elevate our service and sales game.
- Innovate & Progress: Take the initiative to learn new things and provide suggestions for assisting the business growth.
- Feedback Champion: Embrace feedback enthusiastically, using it as a tool for growth.

CUSTOMER SERVICE REQUIREMENTS
- Excellent communication skills
- Customer focused
- Self-motivated
- Able to manage complaints professionally
- Keen to drive business forward
- Ideally experienced dealing with customers on the telephone
- Passionate about helping people
- Team player
- Able to work in a fast-paced environment
- Excellent PC skills
- Problem solver
- Patient
- Able to work under pressure
- Due to location, it is preferred you have you own transport

PACKAGE AND BENEFITS
- Working 2 shifts Monday to Friday 9am-5.30pm and 9.30am-6pm
- Working 1 Saturday per month 9am-3pm
- 20 days holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Onsite Parking
- £26,500 - £30,000 plus commission
- Fantastic opportunity to build a career
- Excellent ongoing training and support
- Fun days and events
- Feel valued everyday
